people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: King Solomon made himself a carriage of the wood of Lebanon.
translations.bsb: King Solomon has made his carriage out of the timber of Lebanon.
translations.kjv: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
translations.asv: King Solomon made himself a palanquin Of the wood of Lebanon.
